{{Quote|You will fall back and follow. Once you know ''where'' they have landed, you will have our security people -- who you will have put on alert -- meet you, recover the boy, and ''kill'' the others. ''Fail'' me in this, and I will find an ''inventive'' means for your ''demise''.|Rodas Borgin, to Hovus Jorrick|<ref name="AotE:HT4" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] maintained '''security forces''' that served as a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]].<ref name="AotE:HT2" /> In the aftermath of the [[Jahan Cross]]'s [[Infiltration of The Spike|infiltration]] of [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|the Spike]], [[Candra Tymon]] was removed from her position as [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] of [[House Dooku]] due to her inability to protect [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku]] and the fact that [[Aveca Dunn]], Dooku's kidnapper, escaped from her [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="AotE:HT4" />
